speaker: Doctor
text: I see you have a history of gait and limb ataxia; to understand the underlying cause, could you tell me if you have any history of cancer, particularly testicular cancer? Also, have you noticed any involuntary eye movements or nystagmus?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that description. Given your history, have you experienced any vision changes, such as blurred vision, or difficulty coordinating your eye movements? Additionally, have you noticed any recent weight loss or night sweats that might suggest an underlying systemic issue like malignancy?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text:
REQUEST TEST: MRI Brain with contrast, focusing on the brainstem and cerebellum. Also, REQUEST TEST: Serum JC Virus (JCV) index. Given your history of Crohn's disease and natalizumab use, we must urgently rule out Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML).

DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML) secondary to natalizumab therapy.
